_comment: cg26s: the JEPA index readouts (inference.jindex). Keys starting with _ are ignored by scripts/merge_overrides.py.
_inf_jx: train the index each sleep and print the JEPA INDEX readouts; readouts only, the trunk is not trained
_inf_jx_dim: encoder width and depth (about 3M parameters); local runs use 128 x 3
_inf_jx_nce: 0 = pure V-JEPA (EMA target, L1, no negatives); > 0 adds InfoNCE over the batch (the toy: helps when facts share a subject)
_inf_jx_pool: the most recent live stored sentences that are keyed
